title: Competitor ads scan
description: What the category is running before cstack makes ads (F91, owner's rule 2026-10-05): 5 to 10 rivals' live ads, each with its link, how long it has run, format, hook, offer and claim, ending in a saturation and white-space map every bet cites. Collected by a person's browser or an approved API (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Foreplay), never scraped. Evidence for analysis, never production input.

sources.description: where the ads were seen: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Foreplay, the brand's own feed, a store

link.description: the ad's library or post URL, or a screenshot path in work/competitors/

first_seen.description: the ad's start date as the library shows it

days_running.description: a weak proxy for a winner, never proof

format.description: static, carousel, UGC talking head, demo, before-and-after, founder, creator duet

hook.description: the first line or first second

saturated.description: the hooks, formats and claims everyone runs

white_space.description: mechanisms nobody in the category uses yet, or that work next door
